art.title: A morning with an agent
art.creator: Ouro UI
art.modifications: None: Hand-drawn for Ouro UI; MIT. A person and their agent at one desk; the person wears a tool belt, with no cap. Lines take currentColor; the person's tool belt and heart read --duo-heart (else a fixed amber), the agent's eyes, antenna and glow --duo-eye (else a fixed teal), and its visor --duo-visor (else a fixed navy).
